title: Crab Rave
blurb: Noisestorm released this tropical house track on Monstercat in 2018, paired it with a video of crustaceans dancing in formation, and the internet immediately understood it as the sound of something ending well. The joke has always been about celebrating an absence: a bad thing cancelled, a villain finally facing consequences, a policy quietly withdrawn. Schadenfreude rarely sounds this joyful, and it is genuinely a good piece of production, which helps. Play it whenever the correct response to news is not sympathy but dancing. The crabs have gathered. The crabs are pleased.
origin: Noisestorm's 'Crab Rave' (Monstercat), the internet's celebration anthem.
